name: Signature
description: Draw a signature with a finger, pen or mouse, or type a name. Saved as a trimmed PNG in the form's attachments.

props.name: pen_color
props.label: Ink colour
props.description: Defaults to dark ink on a white background, or the theme's text colour on a transparent one.

props.name: background
props.label: Background
props.description: The saved image's background. White prints and previews well everywhere.

props.name: allow_typed
props.label: Allow a typed signature
props.description: Shows "Type your name instead": the name is drawn in a handwriting font. This is the keyboard-accessible way to sign.

output.description: The signature image as an uploaded file (a list of one, like Attachments)

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the drawing area and the buttons. Keyboard users choose "Type your name instead", type their name and press Enter (or "Use this signature"). Undo removes the last stroke, Clear empties the pad, "Sign again" replaces a saved signature.

author: UserTasks
